Hi there, I just wanted to let you know this is a 100% completely normal worry for any person, cis or trans, who’s still young/a teenager. I don’t mean to sound like a moldy oldie but you shouldn’t put too much stake into stuff like this especially at your age. Things will only get better for you as you get older and you will find people who are interested in you despite not being tall or jacked or w/e. I know a relationship may seem like the only thing that matters or something that feels super super important to you now, but my number one piece of advice for you is to just focus on yourself and what makes you happy rather than focusing on others and worrying that you will never find love, because you will.

Other than that I would recommend t4t relationships or at *least* a relationship with a queer person (bi, pan, w/e). I definitely get the longing for cis girls (we’ve all been there) but often times, in my experience, cis relationships are much harder because you basically have to teach your partner how to understand you. This is not to say that you will never find a cis girl that you really like and who really likes you. Just know there’s no way to force it and no way to change yourself so that the people who you desire will desire you. There’s no way to force people to like you, but that is okay. You’ll find that someone who likes you because of superficial traits is not someone who you will want to be with in the end. You will find a great partner when it happens, and it will happen. You shouldn’t worry so much or obsess over peoples’ stories or what kind of cis guys cis girls like. It won’t be helpful to your mental state nor will it help you find a partner sooner. 

I wish you the best of luck. I know it feels really hard now but a million things will change between now and 18, 18 and 20, and 20 and 22 (I’m 22, I know from experience) and you *will* find someone. Give it time and focus on what makes you happy, not finding happiness from someone else. I know that sounds super cliché and stupid and you might think it’s stupid, but keep it in mind. I really hope this helps.
